name: Ableton Push 2
description:
Grid cells: Note On, row r (0=top) col c (0=left) -> note = (9-r)*8 + c + 28 (top row = 92-99, bottom row = 36-43).

Scene buttons (below the display, left to right): CC 20-27; these use CC for both button press input and LED feedback.

LED colour palette (index 0-127, documented subset): 0=off 122=white(204,204,204) 123=light-gray(64,64,64) 124=dark-gray(20,20,20) 125=blue 126=green 127=red.

Animation channels: 0=static, 6=pulse(1/24)...10=pulse(1/2), 11=blink(1/24)...15=blink(1/2); ch10 (slowest pulse, ~0.5s at 120 BPM) used for idle/dim states, ch6 (fastest pulse) used for connected highlights, ch11 (fastest blink) used for pending/learn states.

spec type 4 (from-slot-type) sends Note On for pad cells, CC for scene buttons. Push 2 must be in User mode (not Live mode) for direct MIDI control.
